appDescription: A vehicle routine builder that lets users create, review, edit and test visual automation workflows.

function.name: CREATE_ROUTINE
function.description: Open a natural language routine request for draft creation and user review.

requestText.description: The user's requested situation and actions.

function.name: EDIT_ROUTINE

routineId.description: The exact identifier of the routine to edit.

requestText.description: The requested change to the routine.

function.name: CONTROL_ROUTINE
function.description: Open a saved routine control request for explicit confirmation in the app.

routineId.description: The exact identifier of the routine to control.
